title: Acute Protocol: Coronary & Angina Triage
trigger_condition: Acute chest pain, resting HR > 120 bpm, SBP > 180 or < 85 mmHg
steps_json: ["Halt all physical exercise (ergometer/ARED) immediately and secure crew member in sleep station harness.", "Deploy Clinical Medical Pack Alpha: Initiate 12-lead ECG telemetry stream to Flight Surgeon console.", "Administer supplemental oxygen via oral-nasal mask at 4 L/min.", "Verify astronaut has not consumed sildenafil or PDE-5 inhibitors; prepare chewable Aspirin 325 mg.", "Maintain direct voice link with Houston Flight Surgeon on Air-to-Ground 1 (or autonomous protocol if Mars comms delay > 5 min)."]

title: Acute Protocol: Presyncope & Orthostatic Instability
trigger_condition: Presyncope, SBP < 90 mmHg, post-landing/gravity transition dizziness
steps_json: ["Secure astronaut in supine position with feet elevated to alleviate cephalic hypoperfusion.", "Administer 1.0 L oral electrolyte rehydration solution within 60 minutes.", "Check continuous blood pressure cuff every 5 minutes for postural hypotension.", "Verify cabin CO2 levels on ECLSS sensor (ensure < 2.5 mmHg partial pressure).", "Activate lower-body compression garment / LBNP countermeasure if transitioning gravity fields."]

title: Acute Protocol: Vestibular Ataxia & Otolith Decompensation
trigger_condition: Balance score < 62%, joint asymmetry > 13°, acute vertigo/nausea
steps_json: ["Anchor crew member to primary handrails to prevent rotational tumble and head impact.", "Restrict rapid head movements in pitch and yaw axes (mitigate Coriolis effect).", "Administer Promethazine 25mg IM or oral if accompanied by active space motion sickness (SMS).", "Inspect cabin air intake filters for particulate, Lunar/Mars dust, or chemical irritants."]

title: Acute Protocol: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Alert
trigger_condition: SPE flux > 50 mSv/hr or CANS/RAD dosimeter surge alert
steps_json: ["Immediately sound habitat klaxon: all crew retreat to Aft Water Wall / polyethylene storm shelter.", "Terminate ongoing Extravehicular Activities (EVA) within 8-minute airlock contingency window.", "Record active personal dosimeter (RAD) and CSA CANS neutron spectrometer readings immediately.", "Deploy auxiliary polyethylene shielding blankets over crew bunk positions.", "Await Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) real-time flux clearance before resuming EVA."]

title: Acute Protocol: Hypoxia / Decompression Sickness (DCS) Triage
trigger_condition: SpO2 < 90%, cabin depressurization, joint pain ('bends') post-EVA
steps_json: ["Don emergency 100% O2 mask or seal EVA suit pressure loop immediately.", "Verify cabin total pressure, PPO2, and ppCO2 on ECLSS console.", "If DCS suspected post-EVA, initiate hyperbaric treatment protocol (suit/airlock repressurization + 100% O2).", "Log neurological exam, pulse oximetry, and vital signs every 5 minutes."]

title: Acute Protocol: SANS Visual Acuity & Intracranial Pressure Shift
trigger_condition: Acute hyperopic shift, scotoma, IOP > 22 mmHg, or sustained EAR < 0.195
steps_json: ["Perform in-flight Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), Fundoscopy, and Tonometry IOP check.", "Measure visual acuity using onboard Amsler grid and Space Anticipation Glasses calibration.", "Check cabin ppCO2 (< 2.0 mmHg target, as elevated CO2 worsens cerebral vasodilation).", "Schedule LBNP session and review one-carbon / B-complex nutritional status."]
